Regularize the gradient of the scalar field to have unit norm, enforcing the distance field property [S1][S4, unofficial].

The claim states that the gradient of the scalar field is regularized to have unit norm to enforce the distance field property. This regularization is standard for enforcing the Eikonal equation, which is a property of distance fields (where the gradient magnitude is 1). Therefore, the evidence supports the claim.
